principles.no_fabrication: A benchmark result exists only when a HF Jobs run produced a typed VISUAL_BENCHMARK_RECORD (Art. VI, XVI).
principles.fail_closed: Every missing dependency is a typed failure code, never an improvised substitution (Art. IV).
principles.unrun_is_not_rejected: Candidates without runs stay NOT_RUN; infrastructure failure is INCOMPLETE_*, never REJECTED_* (Art. LXI).
principles.presentation_only: All benchmark outputs are COMPUTATIONAL_RENDER; metrics measure presentation acceptance, never engineering validation (Art. XXVIII, LXXII).
principles.single_geometry_authority: Reference inputs are always derived from Coder 1 canonical geometry through the canonical renderer; no second geometry source (Art. X, LXXII).
principles.baseline_supremacy: The canonical GLB is the fixed baseline; the same instrument (metrics.py) measures every candidate arm (Art. XLVII).
principles.referee_independence: Multi-view consistency scoring uses Depth Anything 3 as an instrument separate from every generator (Art. XLV).

fixtures.resolution: Full hashes and GLB bytes are resolved from the canonical repo at run time and verified by sha256 before use; prefixes are the R446-HF-PRO cross-host reproducibility anchors.

procedure: 1. Resolve the case fixture GLB from the canonical repo; verify sha256 against the anchor prefix.
2. Read the candidate's registry entry; check license gate (COMMERCIAL_BLOCKED requires --internal-eval-only and stamps the record).
3. Probe hardware live (torch cuda mem_get_info); compare against the entry's vram_requirement claim; record measured peak.
4. Emit canonical reference inputs via the Coder 2 canonical renderer (typed hook; no ad-hoc renderer).
5. Run the candidate adapter on HF Jobs hardware; collect output mesh + timing + measured peak VRAM.
6. Compute geometry-fidelity metrics with benchmark/metrics.py (deterministic, seeded).
7. Score multi-view consistency with the Depth Anything 3 referee when reference views were supplied.
8. Append observed failure modes (typed codes) to the registry entry.
9. Write the typed record; the registry entry's benchmark status moves NOT_RUN -> COMPLETED only on a completed record.

metrics.normalized_chamfer_p95_over_diag: 95th-percentile two-sided chamfer distance between canonical and candidate surface samples, normalized by the canonical bbox diagonal (rotation invariant).
metrics.max_abs_axis_deviation_pct: Maximum per-axis bounding-box dimension deviation, axes sorted by length on both sides (rotation invariant).
metrics.volume_deviation_pct: Signed volume deviation of candidate vs canonical.
metrics.multi_view_depth_consistency: Cross-view depth agreement of generated views scored by the Depth Anything 3 referee (metric variant).
metrics.material_channel_inventory: PBR channels present on the candidate output; visual differentiation vs the raw GLB identity.
metrics.part_count_and_identity: Number of separated parts and whether part boundaries respect engineering component identity.
metrics.before_after_correspondence: Node-identity Jaccard + sorted-axis dimension deviation + normalized chamfer between BEFORE and AFTER geometry (the recorded mutation must be visible as a distinct delta; identity pairs must read unchanged).
metrics.engineering_feature_visibility: Per-component bbox presence + pairwise bbox separation fractions from the canonical GLB bytes — whether declared engineering components are spatially knowable at all (measured from geometry, never from pixels).
metrics.lineage_preservation: sha256 re-measurement of every declared chain hop (canonical root -> artifact); missing -> INCOMPLETE, mismatch -> FAIL, never a pass.
metrics.artifact_determinism: Repeated measurement of the same bytes must yield the byte-identical record; instrument drift voids evidential weight (Art. LXII).

thresholds.ratification: PENDING_OWNER - numbers below are PROPOSED, carry no directive provenance yet, and must not gate anything until ratified (Art. XXVII).

proposed.note: Values are initial engineering proposals to be calibrated on the first measured runs, then frozen before any approval use.

decision_rubric.APPROVE_PRESENTATION_USE: All ratified fidelity thresholds pass AND license gate permits the intended surface AND multi-view referee accepts - grants presentation role ONLY.
decision_rubric.REJECT_GEOMETRY_DRIFT: Fidelity beyond ratified thresholds - candidate excluded from its proposed role; observed failure recorded.
decision_rubric.REJECT_LICENSE: License gate blocks the intended surface - no benchmark output may ship regardless of quality.
decision_rubric.approval_never_means: Approval never grants engineering status, physical validation claims, or entry into the engineering GLB chain.

evaluation_question.was: Does the visual model produce a prettier mesh?
evaluation_question.now: Does the visual model improve human understanding of the engineering state without introducing false engineering implications?

dimension_split.note: engineering fidelity and presentation quality are reported SEPARATELY and never averaged into one score

amendment_history.change: added the four trajectory-understanding dimensions (before_after_correspondence, engineering_feature_visibility, lineage_preservation, artifact_determinism); recorded the upgraded evaluation question; engineering-fidelity and presentation-quality dimensions explicitly separated
